content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working with [product_name] as a client to collect data from a Modbus TCP/IP device. I've populated the data transfer table in the Modbus connection client and set the Local Address to AM. My main concern is how to confirm that [product_name] is reading the data correctly. Since I'm not familiar with [product_name] or [product_name] Soft Comfort, I'm unsure if there's an option to view the data directly. Is it correct to use AM, or should I consider NAI or another option? Thanks in advance!

Personally, I recommend using NAIs. You can connect to [product_name] and activate the online test. Next, you can access the data table and display the values within the VM area. If you select the icon, a window will open where you can enter the addresses.
Thanks a lot! I'll follow your suggestion and use NAI instead of AM.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for confirmation methods to ensure successful Modbus TCP/IP data acquisition with [product_name]. There's uncertainty about which memory type (AM or NAI) is best for monitoring values and where to access real-time data using [product_name] Soft Comfort. The advice highlights the use of NAIs and online test mode for displaying data, indicating that clearer guidance and discoverable features for monitoring live Modbus values in [product_name] Soft Comfort would benefit users unfamiliar with the platform.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy way to monitor live Modbus data acquired by [product_name] and seek clear guidance on the correct choice of address types for effective verification.
pain_keywords: confusion over memory type (AM vs NAI)
